quest.title: The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken
quest.description: "An ancient legend resurfaces, and new clues to a priceless treasure are found. A band of chivalrous pirates hones their weapons and hoists the sails..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: Staff and equipment in position. Mechanisms are prepped and ready.

dialogues.speaker: Park Announcement Speaker
dialogues.text: This performance of "The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken," a play from "Daiya's Three-Day Reverie," will now begin!

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: Docked in the port closest to the rumored location of the treasure, the crew of the pirate ship "Black Nacre" is recruiting new sailors and restocking before the final and most crucial leg of the voyage...

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: Experienced adventurers set foot on the deck of the Black Nacre. They're outstanding fighters, but novice sailors...

dialogues.speaker: Chief Mate
dialogues.text: Ahoy there, landlubbers! Get on over here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? The voice from the speaker changed. It sounds like someone really serious is calling us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, it's trying to interact with us?

dialogues.speaker: Chief Mate
dialogues.text: Who else would I be talking to? You're the best out of this sorry bunch of scallywags, we can't set sail without you!

dialogues.speaker: Chief Mate
dialogues.text: I'm the Chief Mate of the Black Nacre! You'll be working with me on this voyage, savvy?

dialogues.speaker: Chief Mate
dialogues.text: Perk up, sailors! It's your first day on deck, and our quartermaster will make sure you get the best preserved meat, cream, hardtack, and Dandelion Wine!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
The speaker continues to narrate the scene before you—

The Chief Mate appears to greet the raw recruits, dressed in ragged clothes and swaddled in bandages.
It is obvious that he has just survived a fierce fight.
Looking around, you see most of the sailors are seriously wounded...
However, they are in high spirits, showing no signs of fear or being discouraged...
The sailors gather around you, applauding the newcomers and offering welcome gifts and food.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So the speaker also provides detailed narration of the scene, like the scene just now — we were just welcomed onboard the Black Nacre...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... shall we play along?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, thank you, thank you everyone! We haven't had the preserved meat or hardtack here yet, but they must be tasty!

choices.text: It's a pity that we can't see the actors or props.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... the attraction is called "Three-Day Reverie," so are we just supposed to rely on our own powers of daydreaming?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Though, it probably does save a lot on costs... Building a real pirate ship, actually being able to sail anywhere at a moment's notice... That must be expensive...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But still! Only having a narrator is too far. We can only imagine so much!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, Paimon will give it a try...

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: As the noise dies down, a powerful-looking man appears on the bridge.

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: He is dressed just like a common sailor, save for the ragged tricorne on his head. His left hand is missing, replaced by a rusty hook.

response.speaker: Chief Mate
response.text: Attention on deck! Captain Will's arrived!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: The time is now, me hearties! Get to your positions, double check your weapons and our supplies, and prepare the ship! Get ready to weigh anchor!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! The Captain is here. He sounds so calm... and reliable!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: The treasure isn't far now, lads! The final leg of the voyage is by far the most important!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Our wounded comrades, drowned supplies, lost Dusk Birds, and even the casks of rum we scrimped and saved for... the price we paid will not have been in vain!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: As long as we find the legendary treasure, we can appease the Kraken before the deadline! Never again must we seek dishonest merchants to plunder for pocket change!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: So give it your all, you scurvy seadogs! Do it so our town may know peace, and our friends and family need no longer fear tyranny and toil! Full speed ahead!

response.speaker: Sailor
response.text: Treasure! Treasure! Full speed ahead! For peace!

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: Having welcomed powerful new recruits aboard, the Black Nacre prepares to weigh anchor and set sail for the treasure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oooh, the speaker really set the scene! The goal of these pirates is really different from what Paimon imagined... Paimon's curious what happens next!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The speaker said we can ride the Choo-Choo Cart to continue the play... Paimon likes this pace!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Anchors aweigh, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: Paimon and me, that's how it's gonna be!
Otherwise, this could be quite immersive.

talks.objective: Set off on the Choo-Choo Cart
Go to the location of the hidden treasure
Set off on the Choo-Choo Cart
Go to the location of the hidden treasure
Go to the location of the hidden treasure

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: Marvelous! Congratulations! With the strength of the new sailors, Captain Will easily defeats his old enemies, sending them running.

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: Having overcome every challenge the voyage could throw at them, nothing can stop the crew of the Black Nacre now!

dialogues.speaker: Captain Will
dialogues.text: Such is the loyal crew of the Black Nacre, me lads! Even when those lily-livered biscuit eaters ambushed us, not one of you panicked...

dialogues.speaker: Captain Will
dialogues.text: And of course, our newest crewmembers contributed mightily! They swept away all opposition like it was so much flotsam and jetsam!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Of course! Bad pirates like that? Paimon and {NICKNAME} could fight two or three boatloads more!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I—It's okay! The journey was pretty thrilling, and we've been through thick and thin with Captain Will. So Paimon can be a bit more serious!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Based on our research, if we break that stone wall, we can find the legendary treasure.

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: The crucial moment has arrived. I shall give the honor to our heroes, our new companions!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: And after that, I've got a new idea I'd like to discuss with all of you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}! See how much the Captain values us? He's even letting us handle something as important as this!

response.speaker: Chief Mate
response.text: Get ready to celebrate, lads! Heroes, go ahead and open it!

choices.text: Guess it's not that bad after all?

talks.objective: Go to the location of the hidden treasure

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! We found it! The legendary treasure! So much Mora, Paimon can really swim in it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, why does this Mora seem different from the Mora we usually see? Don't tell Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: Hey! The legendary "pool of Mora" is actually just a bunch of decorative fake coins!?

dialogues.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
dialogues.text: Faced with such an unexpected development, what will the crew of the Black Nacre do?

dialogues.speaker: Chief Mate
dialogues.text: Captain! We were hornswoggled! Could our intel have been wrong? The legendary treasure... how could it all be fake?

dialogues.speaker: Captain Will
dialogues.text: No wonder I had a bad feeling about this.

dialogues.speaker: Captain Will
dialogues.text: The so-called legendary treasure could be bait— luring us into a trap.

dialogues.speaker: Captain Will
dialogues.text: And their goal: the very people who braved hell and high water in search of treasure... and the quality weapons and advanced ships they bring with them.

dialogues.speaker: Captain Will
dialogues.text: The sailors, exhausted by the journey, can easily be captured and sold as labor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, NO! We were all tricked! How could this be a giant trap!?

choices.text: From a cost perspective, it makes sense.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Uh... you have a point. Paimon forgot we were acting...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, even though there aren't any other actors, and the set is a bit shabby, Paimon can tell a lot of work went into this! Paimon thinks we should respect that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's hear what our crewmates from the Black Nacre have to say!

response.speaker: Narrator On Speaker
response.text: Captain Will gathers the inconsolable sailors in front of the fake treasure.

response.speaker: Chief Mate
response.text: Captain, is this... is this the doing of your enemies?

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: No, this is beyond them. If we didn't make it, they'd be disappointed in their old foe.

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Perhaps... the ones behind this are on their way here now. Given our current state, it wouldn't be wise to take them head on.

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Clean up the area, see if there are any chests we missed, and get ready to withdraw.

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Ho! I always said hard work is rewarded. See that chest over there? It's for our newest sailors, who've done so much! No arguing, it's theirs even if the rest of us go home empty-handed!

response.speaker: Sailor
response.text: Ugh... Not only did we not make any money, we racked up a lot of losses!

response.speaker: Sailor
response.text: What're we going to do? Keep searching for dishonest profiteers to try and scrape together enough booty to satisfy the Kraken?

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: I was about to point out that on this voyage, we of the Black Nacre found a treasure more precious than Mora, and are not going back with nothing to show for it!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: We found the ways to cross the roaring seas, strategies to defeat our enemies, and the courage to face any challenge!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Think about it, me buckos! Even if we found an ocean of Mora, would it really buy peace for our town?

response.speaker: Sailor
response.text: ...That makes sense...

response.speaker: Sailor
response.text: We all know how greedy the Kraken is. No matter how much treasure we shove down its filthy gob, it'll always ask for seconds!

response.speaker: Sailor
response.text: Aye, he's right. I've heard even rich towns have given it dozens of times more treasure than we, yet still it hungers.

choices.text: The problem is that appeasement of a monster...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're right! If it was up to Paimon, we wouldn't let that monster have its way. But the Captain and his crew are just ordinary people...

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: So, we must solve the problem at its source! That's why giving it more Mora doesn't make any sense.

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: With the fighting experience we gained on this voyage, I'm sure we can defeat the Kraken, and lift the shadow it casts over our town!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Come, me hearties, do you trust your Captain?

response.speaker: Chief Mate
response.text: It sounds risky, Captain, but it's worth a shot.

response.speaker: Sailor
response.text: This is the only way. If we keep giving in, eventually we'll have nothing left... and we'll have nowhere to run.

response.speaker: Sailor
response.text: The Captain's right! It's worth risking our lives for. We can't take it any longer!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Then it's settled! From now on, I will train everyone on the Black Nacre for this sole purpose.

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Especially now! Our newest crewmates are true swashbucklers, they're practically invincible!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Captain Will is by no means a rich man, but if you lend us your strength, the whole crew of the Black Nacre will do everything in their power to repay you.

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Will you voyage with the Black Nacre, train with us, and punish that Kraken for its perfidy?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! That's the spirit! Be brave, and fight that awful sea monster!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's help our friends on the Black Nacre!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Arrr, amazing! Yer no longer novice sailors, yer old salt, core members of the Black Nacre crew! Yer my helpers and the saviors of the rest of my crew and all the people in town!

response.speaker: Captain Will
response.text: Now it's time for the Black Nacre to return to port. We'll rest up and prepare for our final battle against the beast!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text:
The speaker begins to summarize the end of the first act——

After triumphing in numerous trials, the new sailors are now pillars of the crew.
Led by Captain Will, the crew is preparing for a crucial counterattack...
Please stay tuned for the Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken Act II: "The Black Nacre Strikes Back"!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The narration ends, and the motion of the mechanisms inside the cave grinds to a halt. Silence reigns once more...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, it just ends there? Paimon was just starting to get into it!

choices.text: Maybe they haven't finished the Kraken yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You have a point there. If the play was any longer, most guests would be too tired to fight a sea monster...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And the set really could use some work. Something as exciting as a boss fight deserves a proper stage!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Daiya's Three-Day Reverie certainly has potential! Paimon's getting curious who this Daiya person is!

choices.text: Kind of nice to have an intermission.
They can't actually have a pool of Mora here.
